page.overview:
Who is Penelope de la Rosa?

Penelope de la Rosa (ペネロペ・デ・ラ・ロサ Penerope de ra Rosa) is a major ally featured in the light novel JORGE JOESTAR. She tutors Jorge and acts like an elder sister to him. She lives with the Joestars and works for Erina's trading company. She later develops a Wound because of her traumatizing history with her ex-boyfriend and was a victim of Javier Cortez's Wound.

After following Joji back to his universe, she marries his adoptive father, Jonda Joestar. The two have a daughter a year after their marriage, now having the name Penelope Joestar.

Penelope is described to have pink hair and wears sun dresses. She has short hair and wears lipstick and nail polish. In the illustrations throughout the novel, her hair appears to be blonde, while on the covers, it is pink.

When working for Erina, she wears glasses and ties her hair up and wore a knee-length dress. Jorge describes her to be beautiful as well.
